# Independent exact-SHA review — FAIL (wrong ticket scope)

Reviewed revision: `5af1cfb830ab29c0d702fcfebcd8c2cdece1bb05`

Declared parent: `07a7b5fa551c7f8625b536f88ca2741bcc04b874`

Reviewer session: `botchy-roomy-acouchi` (`cea4-276c-40a8-474d`)

The reviewer did not author, modify, amend, rebase, or push this revision. The worktree remains clean at the exact reviewed SHA.

## Blocking finding: candidate implements a different certified leaf

Authoritative `rebar show censorious-stinky-tortoise` confirms that ticket `0302-f5d0-aa57-4d5c` is “cohort 01: opcert_helpers–amend_msg_change_id.” Its current file impact and signed plan-review manifest pin 18 paths beginning with `tests/unit/_opcert_helpers.py`, `tests/unit/conftest.py`, and `tests/unit/gold_set_completion.py`, and ending with `tests/unit/test_amend_msg_change_id.py`. Its stable allowlist contains 36 blocks with 4,108 before-words at `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`.

The candidate changes a disjoint 18-path set beginning with `tests/unit/test_det_measurement_provenance_heldout.py`, `tests/unit/test_detached_child_cwd.py`, and `tests/unit/test_divergence_grade_split.py`, and ending with `tests/unit/test_eval_solver_project_criterion.py`. None of the 18 recorded `0302` paths changes. A raw sorted-set comparison proves that the candidate path set instead exactly equals the current file impact of `busy-mirky-borer` (`029a-c2e8-b4af-44db`); its local validator also reproduces `029a`'s 36-block, 4,132 -> 1,085 word census and immutable base `9e6a0e436520f67962c22dc244d7b4f77f5bee45`.

The `rebar-ticket: 0302-f5d0-aa57-4d5c` trailer does not cure the content/scope mismatch. The implementation-evidence comments on this ticket therefore describe `029a` work, not this ticket's signed plan.

## Required recovery

Do not push this SHA as `0302`. A non-reviewer author may repurpose the unpushed content for already-certified `029a` by correcting the commit trailer and then obtaining a fresh independent exact-SHA review of the resulting commit. `0302` still needs a separate comments-only implementation of its own signed 18-path/36-block allowlist.

Per the ticket protocol, zero TSV PASS rows are issued for this SHA. Scoped/full tests were not run because they cannot validate an implementation that changes zero ticket-owned paths.
